title: 35 mm camera-scanning carrier
engineering: Narrowing the two guide strips from 36.20 to 35.55 mm reduces worst lateral play from 1.55 to 0.90 mm while retaining 0.30 mm insertion clearance.
physical_check: Measure actual developed 135 stock, frame and perforations. Reload 20 times, inspect the first and last negatives for scratching and edge crops, and measure film curl and focus against a chosen light source.

title: Motorized indexed photo turntable
engineering: Absolute targets close the full 36-shot revolution, and 380 ms programmed dwell exceeds the modeled settling budget by 20 ms.
physical_check: On the selected motor, gearbox and controller, measure actual steps per revolution, backlash, load settling and indexing with an encoder or optical target. Check trigger isolation, repeatability and shutter delay over three loaded revolutions.

title: Turntable extension platform
engineering: Restricting the payload center of mass to a 60 mm circle increases the worst static tip margin to 13.46 mm.
physical_check: Measure the donor’s foot or contact perimeter, masses, key tolerances, fastener engagement, motor torque and loaded deflection. Verify tip resistance, deck runout and slip with agreed load and inertia.

title: Compact folding LED photo box
engineering: The two-stage side pack stows with 86 mm clearance between sides while retaining 184 mm open side depth.
physical_check: Prototype all fold sequences with real hinge tape and diffuser stack. Inspect LED wiring through the hinges and perform a powered heat, flicker and illuminance-uniformity check.

title: Larger folding LED photo box
engineering: Orienting a 28 × 24 mm rectangular lintel on edge reduces modeled sag from 28.85 mm to 0.26 mm over 610 mm.
physical_check: Measure actual stiffness with material and grain orientation, validate the bearing seats and anti-tip support, then hang the fixture and confirm span, sag, heat and light uniformity.

title: Fold-flat field monitor sunshade
engineering: A 44 mm hood shades the modeled overhead ray while leaving 0.44 mm horizontal and 0.46 mm vertical sight margin.
physical_check: Measure screen offsets and actual bezel attachment lands. Where bezel is narrow, mock up external hook-and-loop tabs, then check connector and button access, touch gestures, fold clearance and glare.

title: Lens rod support saddle
engineering: Extending the apex travel gives 2.30 mm reserve at the large lens and 2.71 mm at the small lens.
physical_check: Check rod variation and binding, pad compression and slip, the selected lens’s static barrel band and the support bracket under lens load. Verify the bracket and clamp fasteners before attaching a camera.

title: Filter-tray matte box
engineering: Raising and widening the front opening restores 3.20 mm of predicted clearance in the 24 mm full-frame bundle.
physical_check: Measure the chosen lens entrance pupil and its travel with zoom, focus and stabilization. On the real system verify edge illumination, flare, filter retention and the moved top flag at its full useful travel.

title: Speedlight beam grid
engineering: Doubling the optical channel to 18 mm narrows the predicted hard cutoff to 27.17° while leaving 64.42% clear frontal area.
physical_check: Measure the flash head and select heat-tolerant stock. Check plate registration, clip retention, peak temperature after repeated flashes and actual beam falloff on a target.

title: Pocket production slate
engineering: The layout increases bilingual fields to 4 mm nominal text size and adds 1.2 mm of nominal hinge clearance.
physical_check: Check actual font rendering and completed marks on the selected board stock. Check legibility at the planned camera distance, dry erase persistence, jaw rub, hinge strength and audio sync over 100 cycles.

title: Smartphone cue teleprompter
engineering: A 170 × 132 mm beam splitter covers the modeled cue and camera-ray bundles and retains at least 3.47 mm at the tightest edge.
physical_check: Check the chosen phone case, mirror panel, coating, polarization, legibility, double images, matte-shroud flare and actual lens exit angle. Proof-load the selected camera and tray mounts during assembly validation.
